Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you can return to the perfect setup without rebuilding it every time. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or checking workload across a team, save the view once and it's ready whenever you need it.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving plenty of room for personal dashboards alongside project-specific setups. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective instead of recreating it individually — great for standups, client updates, or handoffs between teammates.

Saved Views works across your existing lists and boards, with no setup required beyond naming and saving. It's a small addition that removes a repetitive step from everyone's daily workflow.

Ready to try it? Open any list and select Save view to get started.
